purpose: Focused map for the technician prerequisite ordering and its harness infrastructure.

directories.purpose: Focused contracts, registries, maps, workflows, and report template.
Windows technician prerequisite/runtime owners and component-status reporter.
Opt-in validation helpers; never installed implicitly.
Scoped repeatable agent procedures selected through canonical SKILLS.md/TRIGGERS.md routing.
Focused PowerShell completeness and order validation.
English working state, traps, failure behavior, and proof ceilings.

commands.name: Harness completeness
commands.effect: read-only repository validation plus local temp report
commands.proof: component presence, canonical routing, registry/workflow coupling, focused static order checks, documentation contract, and diff hygiene

commands.name: Dependency-free harness contracts
commands.proof: registry, workflow, artifact, skill, hook, canonical routing, and CI contract semantics

commands.name: Focused PowerShell order validator
commands.proof: source token ordering and PowerShell parseability

commands.name: Component status report
commands.effect: writes local temp JSON/Markdown unless -NoWrite is supplied
commands.proof: component presence and Git identity only; validation readiness is deliberately not claimed

deploy.reason: Deployment and live workstation mutation are outside this harness-infrastructure sprint.

knownTraps: The prerequisite gate must finish WezTerm and tmux proof before the runtime engine begins higher setup.
Static source anchors are intentionally refactor-coupled; semantic refactors update contract and validators together.
The scoped skill must remain reachable from canonical SKILLS.md and TRIGGERS.md.
Component-complete is not validation-ready; validators and exact-head CI establish correctness.
A green repository harness does not prove runtime installation, WSL state, tmux behavior, visible windows, providers, or operator acceptance.
Generated status and validation artifacts stay outside tracked repository authority.
proofCeiling: Repository and CI harness readiness only; live workstation proof is separate.
